review.why: Prioritized Postgres query, schema, pooling and row-policy guidance with focused SQL references.
review.summary: A database reference that applies beyond Supabase. It covers indexes, connections, schema design and tenant isolation, with SQL examples. Broad performance claims are not substitutes for workload measurements.
cautions: Requires Postgres expertise and workload-specific EXPLAIN checks
Illustrative RLS examples depend on a trusted role/session setup
